card.title: ME BF 109 E
card.flavorText: The Messerschmitt Bf 109, was the main German WWII fighter aircraft of the Luftwaffe. The Bf 109 was first used in service during the Spanish Civil War (1939) and was still in service at the end of WWII by Germany and its Axis partners.  It was one of the most advanced fighters of the era, and conducted more aerial kills than any other aircraft during WWII.
